earlierFailures: Initial baseline discovery overlapped new test creation and failed on not-yet-created modules; not counted as a clean baseline.
Concurrent baseline run: 518/521; three existing UI timeout failures. Existing-suite serial rerun: 521/521. Final verification serializes heavy gates and limits Vitest to two workers.
New backup browser fixture initially omitted required variant tags; corrected fixture, then both integrity cases passed.
First complete browser run: 112 passed, 1 failed (legacy 1440px Show Prompt below fold). Compact Versions menu fixes the layout; unchanged regression passes. Final full results are recorded above.
assumptions: Browser storage remains local to the browser profile and origin. No AI service, bridge or external-write API is introduced.
Text exports preserve the stored string; external clipboard consumers can transform text. This report certifies the observed pinned Chromium payload only.
limitations: Stage B change sets, Stage C MCP pairing and Stage D ChatGPT connectivity are design-only.
Project ZIP includes selected takes, not entire revision history; full-library backup retains history.
Small representative mixed backup tested; no additional ZIP64 capacity certification or PR #12 change.
200% equivalent reflow is tested by viewport size; native browser zoom and standalone screen-reader software were not exercised.
New direct/revision records need an updated app; older binaries are not promised forward compatibility.
GitHub Actions results are supplied on the exact PR commit separately from this pre-commit local report.
